d: Jet black hair is styled in long, flowing layers with straight bangs and a single ahoge sprout at the crown. Golden-yellow eyes are sharp and focused, set on a youthful face with a mature, calm expression. The build is slender and lithe, dressed in a white and black outfit consisting of a white bodice under a black and gold open-front jacket, a short white pleated skirt, and black detached sleeves. Signature details include a gold belt with a hanging tassel, a black sword hilt visible behind the shoulder, and floating yellow paper charms surrounding the figure.
